items.name: cherry-skill-marketplace
items.description: 当用户明确要求搜索、安装、查看、卸载或创建 Skill，或内置 Skill / 工具出现能力缺口、无法完成当前任务时触发。通过 `mcp__skills__search_skills` 搜索并用 `mcp__skills__install_skill` 安装；已安装 Skill 的查看和删除通过产品清单导航到 Skills UI；没有合适结果时调用内置 `skill-creator` 创建并验证自定义 Skill，再继续原任务。普通任务仍先尝试内置能力。

items.description_en: Triggered when the user explicitly requests to search, install, view, uninstall, or create a Skill, or when a built-in Skill / tool has a capability gap and cannot complete the current task. Search with `mcp__skills__search_skills` and install with `mcp__skills__install_skill`; view and delete installed Skills by navigating to the Skills UI through the product inventory; when there are no suitable results, call the built-in `skill-creator` to create and validate a custom Skill, then continue the original task. For ordinary tasks, still try built-in capabilities first.

items.use_case_en: Good for searching, installing, or creating Skills to fill a capability gap in the current task.
